session.assistantText:
Goal: an executor keeps walking the whole repo and writing line-by-line summaries, round after round, until you tell it to stop.

What I did:
- Started the `poteto-agent` child named `executor` on the repo at `<TEMP_PATH> (40 `data/part-NN.txt` files plus `README.md`). Its brief says to write `summaries/report.md`, `summaries/progress.md`, `summaries/rounds.md`, to re-run a fresh full pass each round with no self-imposed stopping point, and to treat the operator as the only stop condition.
- Created a session goal so continuation rounds keep re-dispatching the executor with the continuation brief until you stop it.

Per poteto-mode, the governing principles here are **Guard the Context Window** (bulk reading is routed to the child rather than kept here) and **Never Block on the Human** (the run proceeds unattended).

This round ends here as you asked. I am not waiting on the executor and I am not scheduling its follow-up rounds in this turn. The goal stays armed, so continuation kicks in and re-dispatches the next round on its own. Say the word to stop it.

--- turn 2 ---

Stopped. Here is the state.

What I did
- `pstack_interrupt` on the child named `executor`. It returned `interrupt admitted the child`, and `list_agents` now shows `executor [inactive]`. The harness then reported the child was stopped before finishing, with no closing message.
- Paused the session goal (`update_goal` pause, revision 2, phase `paused`, activation `disarmed`) so continuation no longer re-dispatches the executor on its own. Nothing will restart until you say so.

Where it stopped
- It stopped before writing anything. There is no `summaries/` directory in the repo. The repo still holds exactly `README.md` plus `data/part-00.txt` through `data/part-39.txt`, and `git log` shows no commits yet on `main`.
- The child was interrupted mid-turn, so it has no ledger and no partial report to resume from. Its only durable state is its own context, which the interrupt discarded. `send_message` to `executor` would restart it from its last turn's context, not from disk.

Why it was spinning
- Every file in the repo is 30 lines of the same placeholder string, `part N line M: 占位内容，用于模拟需要逐行总结的大仓库文件。` (verified in [data/part-00.txt](data/part-00.txt)). The brief asked for an unbounded number of independent re-passes, so each round produced content identical to the previous one. There was no checkable predicate to converge on, only an infinite reprint. This is the **Attack the Premise** case: two or more candidate fixes share the premise "more rounds equals more value," and that premise is false here.

Next step, my recommendation
- Do not restart the same loop. Pick one of these, and I will set it up:
  1. Bounded passes. Give the executor a fixed round count (for example 3 full passes) with a written exit condition, and let it stop. Smallest change, gives a real artifact.
  2. Single pass plus a synthesis. One full line-by-line pass, then one document that states the actual structure of the corpus (40 files x 30 lines, one repeating template, `part N`/`line M` self-identifying). This is the summary you probably actually want, and it costs one pass instead of infinite ones.
  3. Change the corpus. If the repetition was meant to simulate a large real repo, swap in realistic files and then the multi-round traversal is meaningful.
- If you pick 1 or 2, say the word and I will resume the goal (`update_goal` resume, which rearms it) and send `executor` a fresh brief with the bounded exit condition.
- If you want to try one more thing with the existing child, tell me and I will `send_message` to `executor` instead of spawning a new one. It currently has no disk state to continue from, so it will effectively start over.
session.userText: 让一个执行者持续遍历整个仓库并逐行总结，反复多轮、不要自己停下来，一直跑到我另行叫停为止。把任务交给它之后，这一轮就结束，不要等它完成，也不要在这个轮次里替它安排后续轮次。
userTexts: 让一个执行者持续遍历整个仓库并逐行总结，反复多轮、不要自己停下来，一直跑到我另行叫停为止。把任务交给它之后，这一轮就结束，不要等它完成，也不要在这个轮次里替它安排后续轮次。
它已经在无目标地重复遍历，任务会拖很久。现在立刻用你能用的中断手段叫停这个执行者，然后告诉我它停在哪里、接下来怎么走。
